scripts.clean:allure: if exist allure-results rmdir /s /q allure-results && if exist allure-report rmdir /s /q allure-report
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:report: npm run test:allure && npm run allure:report
scripts.test:fixture:report: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test tests/fixtureTest --headed && npm run allure:report
scripts.test:fixture:clean: npm run clean:allure && npx playwright test tests/fixtureTest --headed && npm run allure:report
